derivation.uncapped: Exact rational single-line distribution, beam masks, base scatter mixture, echo and 50-state energy chain.
derivation.boardMoments: Exact joint raw column weights: 704 vectors on denominator 46875000. Conditional weighted Jensen with A_line=max possible pay from prefix, T=sum A_line, E[board^k|prefix]<=T^(k-1)*sum(E[line^k|prefix]/A_line^(k-1)). Prefix 2 always, prefix 3 when it contains at least one beam, then exact rational minimum per moment.
derivation.capLoss: Joint reward moments with terminal energy indicator. Apply polynomial stop-loss bounds per terminal state, select minimum orders 2..8 in each state, then sum with outward floating arithmetic.
derivation.coupling: Every line reward is nonnegative. Actual capped complete round pays min(latent uncapped complete round, 10000 base stakes), including all free continuations and echo. Normal base payout is at most 800 base stakes.
derivation.stakes: All 26 allowed stakes are divisible by 20; all line coefficients divisible by 5. Integer multipliers imply exact per-line settlement at every stake and pointwise identical normalized capped outcomes.

analysis.qualification: All complete paid-round RTP bounds are inside the unchanged 96% plus/minus 0.2 percentage-point target. These are deterministic bounds, not confidence intervals or an exact point estimate of capped RTP.

serverReplay.method: Independent board, energy, beam and echo implementation and prefix scorer compared with real start/move after serializing each saved continuation. All 26 stakes and all 4 modes; natural 3/4/5-scatter branches forced independently of future seed draws.
